title: Otwin Twin Manifest
description: A complete, portable, language-neutral description of a fitted digital twin. Written and read identically by the Python, Julia and MATLAB implementations.

manifest_version.description: Schema version. Readers MUST warn on a major-version mismatch and MUST preserve unknown fields.

model_class.description: Which model structure. Determines which conformance checks apply.

model_kind.description: The specific model, e.g. water_tank, dc_motor, wang_power_law.

parameters.description: Parameter values. Non-finite numbers are FORBIDDEN: NaN and Infinity are not valid JSON (RFC 8259) and are rejected by Julia's JSON3 and MATLAB's jsondecode.

estimated.description: Names of parameters estimated from data. MUST be a subset of parameters. An empty array means the twin is white-box and MAY be validated against a closed-form answer; a non-empty array means grey-box and validation MUST use held-out data with a baseline.

leakage_free.description: MUST be a JSON boolean, not 1/0 and not a string. Readers MUST treat any non-true value as not validated.

calibration.description: Canonically the output of Interval.to_dict(), or a summary of it.

created.description: UTC, second resolution, Z suffix. Offsets and fractional seconds are FORBIDDEN: Julia's Dates.DateTime cannot parse an offset without TimeZones.jl, and MATLAB's datetime needs an explicit InputFormat for microseconds.

skill.description: Model error divided by baseline error. The headline metric. Below 1 means the model beats its baseline.

r2.description: Present for familiarity only. NOT a headline metric for forecasting.
